summary: All three round-1 findings are resolved. TR-1 (false-green cursor-move test) is fixed with the exact litmus approach prescribed: s1→tail (2 sends) vs entry→End (1 send), asserting sentCount()-before==1 AND currentStepId==null. The test now fails if claimForRedirect stops setting currentStepId=entryStepId. TR-2 (allowReEnter=false active in-flight swallow path) is covered by the new eventEntryStep_insertAtEntryDuplicate_isSwallowedPerFunnel unit test, which stubs mongoTemplate.findOne to return null (no in-flight) and doThrow(DuplicateKeyException) on insertExecutionAt, then asserts LOG_DISPATCH_REENTER_IGNORED at WARN/INFO and no exception escapes — locking the insertAtEntryStep swallow branch that was never reachable before. TR-3 (drift WARN) is covered by eventMatchedFunnel_inMemoryTriggerDrift_warnsAndFallsBackToStepZero, which seeds a funnel with a tag_added trigger element returned by the event repo query, asserts LOG_DISPATCH_NO_MATCHED_ELEMENT fires at WARN, and verifies fallback to insertExecution (step-0 path, not insertExecutionAt). The cancel-then-insert branch is now exercised with a real pre-existing terminal row via seedTerminalExecution(cancelled). No assertion weakening observed; no vacuous stubs introduced. 98 tests (67+13+18) credibly green.

TR-1.fix: Graph reshaped exactly as prescribed: s1=sendMessageStep('s1','orig','tail'), tail=sendMessageStep('tail','orig-tail',null), entry=sendMessageStep('entry','redirected',null). Cursor seeded on s1. After redirectExecution: (1) assertThat(reload(execId).getStatus()).isEqualTo(completed), (2) assertThat(reload(execId).getCurrentStepId()).isNull() — entry had no next → End, (3) assertThat(sentCount()-before).isEqualTo(1) — entry only, NOT s1+tail. enqueueOk(2) as buffer. If claimForRedirect drops the .set(currentStepId) update, drive runs s1+tail=2 sends and assertion (3) fails. Litmus test passes.

TR-2.fix: Unit test added. stubBotAndSubscriber(); eventFunnel('ev','purchase','entry') seeded; stubEventFunnels(ev); mongoTemplate.findOne returns null by default (no in-flight probe hit → start-at-entry path taken, not redirect); doThrow(new DuplicateKeyException('re-enter')).when(executionFactory).insertExecutionAt(eq(PROJECT_ID), eq(ev), any(), any(), anyInt(), eq('entry')); assertThatCode dispatch doesNotThrowAnyException(); assertThat(warnOrInfo(LOG_DISPATCH_REENTER_IGNORED)).isTrue(). This locks the insertAtEntryStep DuplicateKeyException swallow — the only path previously unreachable. Structurally distinct from the existing reEnter_duplicateOnOneFunnel_doesNotAbortOtherMatches (which routes through insertExecution/step-0, not insertExecutionAt/entry-step).

TR-3.fix: Unit test added. Funnel seeded with a single tag_added trigger (triggerType mismatch for event dispatch). stubEventFunnels(drifted). After dispatch: assertThat(warn(LOG_DISPATCH_NO_MATCHED_ELEMENT)).isTrue() — uses the strict WARN-level helper (not warnOrInfo), verify(executionFactory, times(1)).insertExecution(PROJECT_ID, drifted, SUBSCRIBER_ID, TELEGRAM_BOT_ID, 0) and verify(executionFactory, never()).insertExecutionAt(any()...). Locks the .equals re-scan branch against a type-check regression.

cancelThenInsertBranchWithPreExistingTer.fix: seedTerminalExecution(f.getId(), ExecutionStatus.cancelled, 's1') now seeds a real cancelled row before dispatch. Assertions: (a) fresh running rows == 1 and fresh.get(0).getId() != oldId and fresh.get(0).getCurrentStepId() == 'entry'; (b) mongoTemplate.findById(oldId) still cancelled. Proves the cancel-then-insert branch runs against a real prior row and that cancel is a no-op on a terminal status (row untouched). Previously the test had no prior row, so the branch was exercised in a vacuous scenario.

redirect_in_flight_incl_unpark_waiting_f.quality: strong — status==completed + sentCount==1 proves park cleared and branch ran

redirect_running_waiting_cursor_proved.quality: strong — send-delta (1 not 2) + currentStepId==null are the definitive cursor-move proof; litmus test PASSES

allowReEnter_false_active_inflight_noop_.quality: strong — DuplicateKeyException thrown on insertExecutionAt, LOG_DISPATCH_REENTER_IGNORED asserted, no exception escapes; locks previously uncovered emission site

allowReEnter_true_cancel_then_insert_wit.quality: strong — real pre-existing terminal row; fresh row id asserted distinct from old; old row status asserted unchanged

drift_warn_covered.quality: strong — strict WARN-level check on LOG_DISPATCH_NO_MATCHED_ELEMENT; both insertion paths asserted

emit_event_self_loop_terminates_at_budge.quality: adequate — unchanged; the redundant OR clause (both arms scan the same list for the same constant) is harmless

strictWarnLevelOnNewTests.TR2_test: uses warnOrInfo — acceptable since LOG_DISPATCH_REENTER_IGNORED may be INFO at one emission site (matches existing reEnter_duplicateOnOneFunnel_doesNotAbortOtherMatches pattern)
strictWarnLevelOnNewTests.TR3_test: uses warn() — strict WARN-level check; correct since the drift branch emits at WARN

assertionQualityCheck.notes: The TR-1 test's enqueueOk(2) buffer pattern is correct (one send fires, one stays queued, drained in AfterEach). The before=sentCount() snapshot taken outside the redirect call correctly isolates the delta. The emitEventTriggerSelfLoop test's OR in the budget assertion remains a minor stylistic redundancy but is functionally harmless — both arms check the same constant on the same list.
